description: List LMS Project To-do assignments, aggregate completion, and authorized employer-review/learner in-shell URLs for one organization-owned job. Page mode: pages are bounded (limit 1-200, default 50, newest first) and carry hasMore plus nextCursor; a page with hasMore=true is PARTIAL — continue with cursor until hasMore is false. Complete mode (all=true): follows nextCursor to exhaustion at the requested page size, de-duplicates by assignment id, stops on a repeated cursor instead of looping, and reports hasMore plus collection {pageSize, pagesFetched, collectedCount, complete, finalCursor, stopReason, duplicatesDropped}; any page error fails the whole call (no partial success). Worker email and private answer content are never returned. Requires lms:read.
name: opentrain_lms_list_assignments
